project.name: MOK / P-vs-NP Hard-Core
project.summary: Counterexample-guided structural SAT research with explicit evidence and claim ceilings.
project.description:
Purpose: shrink the exact unresolved SAT hard-core class without promoting bounded evidence into P=NP claims.

Current invariant:
GENERATE != VERIFY != ADMIT

Current executable adapter:

* unit closure
* component factorization
* Horn / dual-Horn
* pure GF(2) affine
* incidence-forest exact DP
* bounded strong forest backdoor
* local additive q-mass contraction
* residual equivalence

Current research object:
the minimized 7-clause / 9-variable HARD_CORE witness from MOK v0.4.

Claim ceiling:
HARD_CORE != LOWER_BOUND
FINITE_PANEL != ASYMPTOTIC_THEOREM
P ?= NP remains OPEN.
